comments.author: @BestTravel2
comments.text: Imagine waking up to mountains, crystal-clear lakes, and endless wilderness right outside your door! British Columbia looks like a dream for anyone who loves nature. I could easily spend months exploring this part of Canada!

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: Right? 😍 British Columbia looks like the kind of place where you plan a short trip and end up wishing you had months to explore. If you had all that time, would you spend more of it hiking in the mountains or relaxing by those beautiful lakes?
